proposed_written_variety: Southern Quechua, Chanka/Ayacucho-oriented, three-vowel convention; not verified

coverage.english: Triadic Brain is being designed to help people think, learn and work together while retaining meaningful control over their computers, information and AI assistance.
coverage.ai_draft: Triadic Brainqa runakuna yuyaymananankupaq, yachanankupaq, kuska llamkanankupaq yanapananpaqmi wakichisqa kachkan; chaywanpas runakunaqa paykunapa ⟦computers⟧ nisqankunata, willakuyninkunata, ⟦AI assistance⟧ nisqatapas chiqapta kamachiyta atinanmi.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: This wording has not been verified to preserve continued meaningful control, rather than merely an ability to command.

coverage.english: Its intended home is a user-owned node that can work locally and cooperate with other independently governed nodes when their owners agree.
coverage.ai_draft: Paypa kananpaq munasqanqa llamkachiq runapa ⟦node⟧ nisqanmi: kaypi kikillan llamkayta atinman, hinaspa hukkunapa sapakama kamachisqan ⟦nodes⟧ nisqakunawan kuska llamkayta atinman, chaykunayuq runakuna arí niptinku.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: Local operation means computation on the user's node, not merely being here or working alone; independent governance and owner agreement require review.

coverage.english: Control Anchor is the human interface for that node.
coverage.ai_draft: Control Anchorqa chay ⟦node⟧ nisqawan runapa llamkananpaq ⟦interface⟧ nisqanmi.

coverage.english: The product is the connected Brain: its task intake, analytical work, evaluation, memory, controls, evidence and cooperation.
coverage.ai_draft: Rurasqa kaqqa tinkusqa Brainmi: ruranakunata chaskisqan, hamutaspa llamkasqan, chaninchasqan, yuyaynin, kamachiykuna, ⟦evidence⟧ nisqa, kuska llamkay ima.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: yuyaynin and kamachiykuna are not validated equivalents for technical memory and controls.

coverage.english: The practical goal is useful, inspectable help for working people and under-resourced institutions.
coverage.ai_draft: Ruraypi munasqanqa llamkaq runakunapaq, pisi yanapakunallayuq ⟦institutions⟧ nisqakunapaqpas allin yanapaymi; chay yanapayqa qawasqa, maskasqa kayta atinanmi.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: Under-resourced includes resources beyond assistance; inspectable means open to examination, not merely visible or searchable.

coverage.english: A community should be able to choose its models, understand where its data goes, set its own resource limits, preserve knowledge it is entitled to keep, and leave a provider or network without abandoning its work.
coverage.ai_draft: Huk aylluqa ⟦models⟧ nisqankunata akllayta, willakuyninkuna mayman risqanta yachayta, paypa yanapakunanpa tukunan saywakunata churayta, waqaychaypaq derechoyuq yachayninta waqaychayta, hinaspa llamkayninta mana saqispa huk ⟦provider⟧ nisqamanta utaq llikamanta lluqsiyta atinanmi.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: ayllu may narrow community; wording for resource limits and entitlement to retain knowledge is unverified. Resource limits must include resources such as compute, storage, time or money, not merely a boundary on help or helpers.

coverage.english: Better-equipped participants could contribute bounded compute.
coverage.ai_draft: Aswan allin llamkana nisqayuq yanapakuqkunaqa saywachasqa ⟦compute⟧ nisqawan yanapakunmanku.

coverage.english: Others could contribute expertise, corrections, reusable methods, accessible explanations or useful negative results.
coverage.ai_draft: Hukkunataq yachayninkuwan, allichaykunawan, yapamanta llamkachina ruray ñankunawan, mana sasalla hamutana sutichaykunawan, utaq manam nisqa kutichiyniyuq allin lluqsisqakunawan yanapakunmanku.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: Useful negative results must not be reduced to answers saying no. Negative findings can be useful evidence; they are not necessarily useless or missing results.

coverage.english: Participation should not require surrendering private records or accepting a donor's conclusions.
coverage.ai_draft: Yanapakuyqa manam sapallanpaq waqaychasqa qillqakunata qunanta, nitaq yanapakuqpa tukuchispa nisqankunata chaskinanta mañananmanchu.
coverage.uncertainty_note: UNRESOLVED: A donor is not necessarily any helper; conclusions are not simply final statements, and private records are not limited to written papers. Participation must not be made conditional on accepting a donor's conclusions.

untranslated_scope: All source passages not explicitly listed; all tables, equations, appendices, references and separate companions; bracketed technical terms inside draft passages.
